summary: 52-year-old man injured his back when ejected from his timber sled while hill climbing near Rabbit Ears Peak. Multi-agency response (Grand, Jackson, and Routt County rescuers; Jackson County SAR, Routt County SAR, MMRT, Classic Air Medical). Subject packaged on an avalanche-prone slope, lowered by rope to a snowmobile crew, and flown to a Greeley hospital.
location: Near Rabbit Ears Peak, Dumont Lake staging
notes: Date approximate: Post says 'Monday, Jan 4' but 2022-01-04 was a Tuesday and the post itself is timestamped Jan 4 10:35 MST describing a Monday mission; weekday rule pins the incident to Monday 2022-01-03. Incident location in Jackson County per post.
